name: Calm
q: The more haste, the less speed
A calm mind sees a calm world
Know where to stop, and you find calm
Not events but our judgments disturb us
In hard times keep an even mind
Without calm you reach nothing far
Stillness is the root of the world
All our woes: not sitting still alone
Reach utter emptiness; hold fast to stillness
Nowhere can man find a quieter retreat than in his own soul
Stillness — the cicada's cry sinks into the rock
Do few things, if you would be calm
Over all the peaks lies peace
